
===| nmcli interactive connection editor |===

Editing existing '802-11-wireless' connection: 'teton-stdin-test'

Type 'help' or '?' for available commands.
Type 'print' to show all the connection properties.
Type 'describe [<setting>.<prop>]' for detailed property description.

You may edit the following settings: connection, 802-11-wireless (wifi), 802-11-wireless-security (wifi-sec), 802-1x, ethtool, match, ipv4, ipv6, hostname, link, tc, proxy
nmcli> set wifi-sec.psk short
nmcli> save
Error: Failed to save 'teton-stdin-test' (761301d0-c05b-4b93-82b6-8edea67c4e6d) connection: 802-11-wireless-security.psk: property is invalid
nmcli> quit
